ModuleName: App Publication Strategies and Store Requirements
CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the module's core topics covering app submission processes for Google Play, Apple App Store, and Microsoft Store, including developer account setup, code signing, build preparation, and store listing configuration, serving as a navigational overview for learners and instructors to understand the module's scope.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: A topic-overview page listing the key subjects in the App Publication Strategies and Store Requirements module — including the Google Play Store submission process, developer account setup, build preparation, and listing creation — which learners can use as a navigational guide to understand what the module covers before diving into individual lessons.

Artifacts.Name: Google Play Store Submission Process
Artifacts.Description: Covers the end-to-end process of publishing an Android app on Google Play, including account registration, build preparation, metadata creation, staged testing, and policy compliance, serving as a reference guide for learners walking through each required stage.

Artifacts.Name: Apple App Store Submission Process
Artifacts.Description: Explains Apple's multi-layered App Store submission workflow, including developer account enrollment, code signing, metadata and visual asset preparation, and the human review process, giving learners a step-by-step reference for releasing iOS applications.

Artifacts.Name: Microsoft Store Submission Process
Artifacts.Description: Describes how to publish a Windows application to the Microsoft Store, walking learners through Partner Center account setup, MSIX packaging, store listing asset assembly, and Microsoft's certification requirements.

Artifacts.Name: Web Deployment Strategies
Artifacts.Description: Covers production web deployment strategies including selecting hosting infrastructure, automating build and release pipelines, configuring SSL certificates, implementing Progressive Web App features, and performance optimisation, serving as a practical guide for learners deploying web applications.

Artifacts.Name: Asset Requirements and Store Listing Optimization
Artifacts.Description: Explains the graphical asset specifications and store listing copywriting requirements across Google Play, the Apple App Store, and the Microsoft Store, helping learners optimise screenshots, icons, descriptions, and metadata to maximise discoverability and conversion.

Artifacts.Name: Build Finalization and Submission Readiness
Artifacts.Description: Details the pre-submission engineering and product management steps required to finalise an app build for public store release, covering quality checks, versioning, signing, and readiness criteria that learners must complete before submitting to any major platform.
